items.t: Says he intends to build on Ohio's record of achievement in education and workforce development during the rest of the DeWine administration.
items.q: A longstanding champion of education and workforce development, Tressel intends to build upon Ohio’s record of achievement in these key areas, and others, throughout the remaining two years of the DeWine administration.

record.t: Was sworn in as Ohio's 67th lieutenant governor in a ceremony in the Rotunda of the Ohio Statehouse, after the Ohio General Assembly confirmed his nomination.
record.q: During a ceremony in the Rotunda of the Ohio Statehouse this morning, Ohio Supreme Court Justice Patrick DeWine officially swore in Jim Tressel as Ohio's 67th lieutenant governor.

record.t: Was nominated by Governor Mike DeWine to serve as lieutenant governor of Ohio, replacing Jon Husted, whom DeWine appointed to the U.S. Senate.
record.q: Ohio Governor Mike DeWine announced this morning that he is nominating Jim Tressel to serve as his lieutenant governor. Tressel would replace Jon Husted, who served as lieutenant governor until Governor DeWine appointed him to the U.S. Senate last month.

record.t: Was nominated by Gov. Mike DeWine as lieutenant governor in February 2025 and confirmed by the Ohio Senate and House.
record.q: Jim Tressel was nominated by Ohio Governor Mike DeWine to serve as Ohio’s lieutenant governor in February 2025, and was subsequently confirmed by the Ohio Senate and the Ohio House of Representatives.

record.t: Served as president of Youngstown State University from 2014 until retiring in 2023.
record.q: Tressel’s career pursuits most recently led him to serve as president of Youngstown State University (YSU) from 2014 until his retirement in 2023.
